title: Running Total by Date
description:
Write an SQL query to calculate the cumulative running total of transaction amounts by date.

Table `Transactions`: `id (INT), transaction_date (TEXT), amount (INT)`
output_format: Date and Running Total separated by space.

sample_tests.input:
CREATE TABLE Transactions (id INT, transaction_date TEXT, amount INT);
INSERT INTO Transactions VALUES (1, '2024-01-01', 100), (2, '2024-01-02', 200), (3, '2024-01-03', 150);

hidden_tests.input:
CREATE TABLE Transactions (id INT, transaction_date TEXT, amount INT);
INSERT INTO Transactions VALUES (1, '2024-05-01', 50);

hints: Specify `ORDER BY transaction_date` with `ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW`.

reference_solution: SELECT transaction_date, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY transaction_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total FROM Transactions ORDER BY transaction_date;
